name: External Collateral Reference Data Status Reason 1 Code
definition: Specifies the status reason, as published in an external collateral reference data status reason code list.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

MFNS.name: All Fields Not Supported
MFNS.definition: All fields in message format are not supported.

EXTN.name: Extension Not Allowed
EXTN.definition: Extension not allowed as there is no end date for original instruction.

IPNS.name: Input Parameters Not Supported
IPNS.definition: Input parameters not supported (when the instruction comes at  thet transaction level).

COMB.name: Instructing Party Counterparty Combination
COMB.definition: Instructing party/counterparty combination is not configured for the instruction type.

NCFG.name: Instructing Party Not Configured
NCFG.definition: Instructing party not configured for the instruction type.

LIST.name: List Identification Does Not Exist
LIST.definition: List identification does not exist for the instructing party.

RMVL.name: Removal Type
RMVL.definition: Does not support this removal type.

SDNM.name: Start Date Original Instruction
SDNM.definition: Start date of original instruction does not match.
